Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Proposal for a Chicago gay rights bill is voted down 2. LA Times poll finds opinion of total population on homosexuals does not align with Jerry Falwell's conservative fundamentalist Christian followers 3. Olympia, Washington, anti-gay group fails to get enough signatures to remove the city's gay rights ordinance COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 4. Justice Warren Burger's attendance at a New York City event protested by the Gay and Lesbian Rights Coalition, with clips COMMERCIAL: Urban General Warehouse Sale 5. SUNY Stony Brook Gay and Lesbian Alliance members harassed by the football team and other students 6. Andy Humm on Civics and New York elections 7. Funding for a Maryland AIDS education organization delayed by Maryland state legislative panel 8. California governor George Deukmejian vetoes a bill protecting people with AIDS from discrimination 9. Washington DC's House and Senate approve amendments to improve funding for AIDS care and research 10. Gay World Series Softball Competition announced COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 11. Outreach: Conversations with GMHC: Interview with Ruth Rodriguez and Dooley Worth on women with AIDS 12. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This week in gay history with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 2. Coverage of the 1986 Gay Games in San Francisco, with clips of the opening ceremony COMMERCIAL: Body Mate exercise equipment 3. Brandon Judell with gossip tidbits and clips from the Phil Donahue Show on violence against gays COMMERCIAL: Water Front Airways 4. Closing credits
